title: Forestrie plan frontmatter
description: Work in flight, kept in forestrie/work. A plan closes by distillation: it is complete only once its durable outcome has landed in canon and is listed in `outcome` (ADR-0071 sections 2, 3, 5, 6).

id.description: The filename stem (or directory name): plan-YYMM-NN-<slug>, or a frozen legacy plan-NNNN-<slug>.

repos.description: The forestrie repositories the work changes.

issues.description: The Linear issues the plan serves.

outcome.description: The canon documents the close-out landed (ADRs, ARC or named-doc revisions, rules amendments), or `none: <reason>` when the plan produced nothing durable.
